brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: 3x keyhole hangers (hex-acc-keyhole) on slot 4 (back face) of each cell -1,0,0 / 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 provides lift-and-drop wall mounting
3x Hook plates (hex-acc-hook) on slot 1 (front face) of each cell; each plate carries two hooks = 6 hooks total across rack

finish.summary: Built 3-cell horizontal rack (q -1,0,0 to 1,0,0). Back side fitted with keyhole hangers for wall mounting, front side fitted with three hook plates (6 hooks) for hand tools. Mesh clash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.use: Hangs a cell on screws that are already in a wall, so mounting is a lift and a drop rather than a drilling job through the cluster.
